finding: The initially reported correction bytes were invalid JSON due to a literal backslash-n suffix after the closing brace. Root independently observed json.loads failure: Extra data at line 63. That exact first serialization was overwritten while adding source pins before the integrity issue was identified, so its bytes could not be preserved verbatim. A byte-preserved reproduction of the same invalid suffix and correction content before the extra source pins is stored separately; it has its own hash and is not represented as byte-identical to the initial serialization.
reproduction_note: Intentional malformed reproduction, ending in bytes 5c 6e (literal \n).
